notes: Tier table for model-router. Each tier becomes the agent type model-router:<tier>, and Claude picks the type that fits the task. Model names are Claude Code aliases, so they follow the newest model of each line without an edit here. Changed by hand or by the weekly refresh (UPDATING.md), always through a pull request.

quick.description: Quick lookups: find, list, grep or read something, check a fact in files or docs. A short, read-only answer.

light.description: Light work: summarize, extract, classify or translate; sweep many files and report; a small mechanical edit such as a rename or a version bump.

standard.description: Well-specified coding: implement a clear change, write or fix tests, fix an ordinary bug, write docs, web research with a synthesis.

deep.description: Hard or open-ended engineering: architecture and plans, multi-file features and refactors, root-causing a tricky bug, code or security review, performance, concurrency.

long.description: Long autonomous runs: tens of minutes or more, a whole codebase end to end, large-scale refactoring or migration.

frontier.description: Only when an Opus agent at high or xhigh effort has already fallen short on this same task, or the user asked for the most capable model. Billed from usage credits on a subscription.
